decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording easy signature insertion in Canva, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Allowing signature insertion in the current letter does not resume or change the deferred modular template requirement.
Signature insertion in Canva does not alter hyperlink coverage or the requirement that links remain functional after export.
The signature-editing request does not change the required PDF format, email submission method, or clean emailable export.
The ability to insert a signature in Canva does not change the requirement for a print-ready PDF.
The source decision concerns signature editing, not the proposal's brand identity, colors, fonts, or logo.
The candidate already separately records the same message's photo-relocation instruction; the signature-editing change does not modify photo inclusion or placement.
Signature insertion in the proposal letter does not affect the count, appendix location, or integration method for team biographies.
The source decision does not change which proposal tables are included or their replacement source.
Enabling signature insertion does not alter the fixed RFQ section order or permit section reordering.
The signature instruction is specifically owned by the one-page letter and editable-source requirements and does not necessarily change the broader document layout strategy.
The source decision does not resolve the Section 6 ambiguity or otherwise change required narrative-section content.
